policy.other: 9/99 requires local OT for exact slot
policy.not_applicable: Only explicitly registered 0/00; capacity and fitment whole 0. No inference.
policy.retirement: Retired entries remain decodable; never reuse meanings. New meanings additive; changed meaning requires namespace.
policy.ordering: Fields ASCII key; dimensions and QC/TO target; groups complete encoding; unknown-order layers multiset with duplicates
policy.text: UTF-8 uppercase percent encoding; only ASCII letters digits hyphen underscore literal
policy.equality: Complete canonical content, never supplier identity, fit or approval

qualifiers.basis_applicability: FILL/BRIM only volume CA; NA only non-volume targets

validation_rules.rule: Grade must exist under local family. Feature uses local article and role. Unknown role permits article feature. Closure role/function only lid-bearing classes.
OT targets exactly equal local OTHER slots; no missing or extraneous explanations.
Known features sorted, first in core; duplicates rejected. Mutual exclusions from feature_rules; BG N may coexist with window/tin tie but not handle.
B/L/A imply BODY/CLOSURE/ACCESSORY; redundant FR omitted, contradictions rejected. LP only known closure with role other than L. AP requires known local closure function.

KW incompatible with non-BLEACHED; KB incompatible with non-UNBLEACHED; recycled grades incompatible with VIRGIN; KV incompatible with RECYCLED/PCR. Construction/family checks from construction_rules only when family known.

Field applicability explicitly local. VIRGIN forbids positive PR; PR within 0..100 including tolerance. NONE cannot mix with positive CO/FC claims. No-handle conflicts with HL. FF requires registered bounded definition and cannot coexist with circular FI.

QC/TO unique existing local numeric targets. Default QC omitted. FILL/BRIM only volume CA, NA non-volume. TO scalar offsets in same canonical unit, nonnegative, count integer, bounds within domain, no interval target.

Only named scopes and one nonempty layer stack per node; repeated consistent scopes merge, conflicts reject; child fields never inherit. Unknown fields omitted in fragments. Empty groups/layers reject.
Unknown-only root rejected. Full canonical re-encoding required on decode. Unsupported fields and vocabulary reject with input retained by caller; never partial success.

grammar:
`A1` names this grammar and meaning namespace.

```text
id       = "A1!" node

node     = core [ "+" fields ] [ "~" groups ]

core     = material "." article "." configuration "." capacity "." fitment

material = family grade treatment
article  = class role
configuration = shape construction feature

capacity = "X" | "0" | ("M" | "G" | "N") amount
fitment  = "X" | "0" | "R" amount

amount   = scalar | scalar "-" scalar
scalar   = integer | decimal | fraction
decimal  = integer "_" digits
fraction = integer "/" positive-integer

fields   = field *( "." field )
field    = key ":" typed-value
key      = two uppercase ASCII letters

groups   = group *( "|" group )
group    = "S(" scope "){" fragment "}"
         | "L(" direction "){" fragment *( ";" fragment ) "}"

fragment = fields [ "~" groups ]
         | "-" [ "~" groups ]

direction = "O" | "X"
```

Rules:

- Material has four characters: family 1, grade 2, treatment 1.
- Article has three: class 2, role 1.
- Configuration has three: shape 1, construction 1, feature 1.
- Measurements have variable length.
- `.` separates fields/blocks; `_` marks a decimal.
- `S` identifies a named surface or intrinsic part of one product.
- `L(O)` is outside-to-inside layer order.
- `L(X)` means layer order is unknown.
- A fragment with no known local fields uses `-`.
- Parsing respects nested brackets, parentheses, and braces.
- Supplier kits have **no component-aggregation grammar inside a Spec ID**.

The full identifier includes every encoded extension and group. Dropping them produces an incomplete preview, not an equivalent Spec ID.
